results.supporting_text: On October 1, 2026, DarkPulse, Inc. ... issued a press release announcing the execution of an Exclusive Patent License Agreement with the Department of the Air Force, Air Force Research Laboratory, Information & Spectrum Warfare and Space Warfare Directorates, granting the Company an exclusive U.S. license to commercialize a package of six patents covering satellite power-sharing, laser, constellation navigation, and hybrid terrestrial-satellite networking technologies, subject to certain rights retained by the U.S. Government and the other terms of the license agreement.
